errors.says: Method: 'stage j adds the bank X into Y along coordinate j (forward invocation), then subtracts Y from X, then adds X to Y again', which literally attributes an X-into-Y addition to every stage j.
errors.paper: Stage 1 is a forward invocation from X to Y, stage 2 is the inverse forward schedule from Y to X (effecting X<-X-Y), and stage 3 is again forward from X to Y (lines 731-733, 761-763). S1.1.2 states this correctly, so the wording is only ambiguous.

errors.says: 'O(p^C) work per polynomial record or Gaussian line is O(dTp^C/r)=o(Tp)'.
errors.paper: Per-record descriptor or address work over all visits totals O(Tp^{A+C}/r)=o(Tp), while setup per Gaussian line totals O(dTp^C/r)=o(Tp) (lines 4927-4937); the statement merges the two counts. S6.4a gives both correctly.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route from start to finish: two finite networks with total edge rank s<Wm (S1.1-S1.4), giving the chunk interchange O(Vu^tau) and the simultaneous layer O(Vd^{lambda'}) (S1.5-S1.6). These feed the synthetic transforms and ring convolution (S2), resampling with chirp and permutation cancellation (S3), the parameter and prime choices (S4), the CRT/twist/source-transform algorithm with exact recovery (S5), and the cost table with min margin 2kappa giving O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}) (S6, S7). Nothing in the chain breaks. The only thin spots are the elementary stream lemmas, which are used but never stated, and the conjecture step, which is a single inline inference.

steps.note: h=100, N=v^3 with v=C(100,3), m=h^3, banks X_a,Y_a over triples, the fixed linear network sending (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) and restoring every scratch wire, with W_b and W_c.
Common invertible frame per gate commuting with the pointwise gate, the operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and edges paying only the change of frame D_vD_u^{-1}.

rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U for nested nondegenerate labels, with the N source edges 2P_{U_a} as rank-one exceptions.
Signed changes sum to Wm-2N, L=Ich, absolute sum Wm-2N+2L, and s_b=(Wm-2N+2L_b)+N=W_b m-N+2L_b.
L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539 below 1/2, so the deficit N-2L_b (and 2N-2L_c) is positive and s<Wm.
M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m on every role (P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m on X_a, 0 to I elsewhere), so the bit network applies H<-H+D on every row, scratch rows included.
A=E_1 Pi E_2 with a ones in Pi; the shear costs exactly a interchanges plus O(V); summing the edge ranks gives exactly s recursive calls per node.
Children on role streams of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50} from eta>20*2^{-50} and log m<20, and the geometric sum giving F_k=O(e^tau).

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the whole central saving with its defining quantities. It covers the h=100 bank-exchange network, frames, labels with the central 3->4 loss of h, rank equal to dimension change plus the N rank-one source exceptions, the budget s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b, the ratios 100/539 and 101/539 below 1/2, the endpoint identity giving the shear on every role, one recursive interchange per unit of rank, and the recurrence F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) with s/W<m^{1-2^{-50}}, giving O(e^tau).
